candidates.evidence: Single Lorentzian 2D band at 2689.8 cm-1 (FWHM 32.3 cm-1, residual at noise level, rms 124 vs ~130 count noise). Height ratio I2D/IG = 2.98. G band at 1579.3 cm-1 (FWHM 14.2). Disorder bands D (1344.3) and D' (1623.1) present. No splitting or asymmetry of 2D that would indicate multilayer stacking. Band positions and ratios match monolayer graphene at 532 nm.

Not excluded by the spectrum alone: the 2D FWHM of 32 cm-1 is somewhat broader than the ~25-30 cm-1 usually quoted for clean monolayers, which a few-layer contribution could also produce. A bilayer would normally show a multi-component 2D with a larger width, and the single-Lorentzian fit leaves no structure, so this is weakly disfavoured.

hint_reasoning: material_hint is null, so this is an identify task with no stated material to verify against. The identification rests on the band positions, widths and ratios, not on a hint.

peaks.source: Position, width and area from a Lorentzian fit with linear baseline over 1250-1700 cm-1 (+-0.16 cm-1). Assignment from literature: Cancado et al., Nano Lett. 11, 3190 (2011), arXiv:1105.0175.

peaks.assignment: G (in-plane E2g stretching mode at Gamma)
peaks.source: Position and width from the same fit (+-0.08 cm-1). Assignment from literature: Cancado et al., Nano Lett. 11, 3190 (2011), arXiv:1105.0175.

Weak component. Fitted at 1623.1 +- 1.0 cm-1 with area 9368 +- 1645 (about 5.7 sigma above the no-D' fit). Assignment from literature: Cancado et al., Nano Lett. 11, 3190 (2011), arXiv:1105.0175. Its width is poorly constrained (+-3.2 cm-1).

peaks.assignment: 2D (second-order overtone of the D mode, zone-edge phonons at K)
peaks.source: Single Lorentzian fit over 2550-2800 cm-1 (+-0.04 cm-1). Centre and width change by less than 0.2 cm-1 with linear or quadratic baseline and window choice. Assignment from literature: Cancado et al., Nano Lett. 11, 3190 (2011), arXiv:1105.0175.

properties.name: material
properties.source: Band set (D, G, D', single symmetric 2D) and positions consistent with graphene at 532 nm. See candidates.

properties.name: layers
properties.source: Qualitative: single Lorentzian 2D with I2D/IG ~3 (height ratio), G FWHM 14 cm-1. The I2D/IG and 2D width thresholds are from memory of Ferrari et al., PRL 97, 187401 (2006); not retrieved in this session.

properties.name: defect_level
properties.source: I_D/I_G = 0.49 (height) / 0.52 (area), from fitted peaks. Low disorder regime, the one where the Cancado 2011 L_D relation is used.

properties.name: L_D_nm
properties.source: Cancado et al., Nano Lett. 11, 3190 (2011), arXiv:1105.0175: L_D^2 = (1.8+-0.5)e-9 * lambda^4 / (I_D/I_G), lambda = 532 nm. Coefficient quoted from memory, not checked against the paper text in this session. Applied at I_D/I_G ~0.5, in the low-defect (inter-defect distance) regime.

properties.name: defect_type
properties.value: vacancy-like (point defects) most likely; boundary-type not excluded
properties.source: I_D/I_D' = 6.3 (height) / 6.7 (area), from the fitted D' (+-~18%). Eckmann et al., Nano Lett. 12, 3925 (2012), arXiv:1207.2058: I_D/I_D' ~7 for vacancies, ~3.5 for boundaries, ~13 for sp3 defects. Ratio values quoted from memory, not checked against the paper text in this session.

properties.name: strain_sign
properties.source: G at 1579.3 and 2D at 2689.8 cm-1 do not show a clear strain or doping signature. Without an in-spectrum Si reference and a reference undoped monolayer at the same calibration, the two cannot be separated.

properties.name: doping_type
properties.source: Same reason as strain_sign. G position is about 2-3 cm-1 below the commonly quoted undoped monolayer value near 1582 cm-1 at 532 nm, which could be calibration or doping; one spectrum cannot distinguish these.

properties.name: phase
properties.source: Graphene has no polytype; identification from band set above.

artifacts.type: cosmic-ray spikes: none detected (robust 6-sigma single-point test, 0 points; noise sigma ~130 counts)
detector saturation: none (max 16682 counts at 2689.7 cm-1; no flat-topped plateau, only 6 points above 16000 with distinct values)
broad background ramp (about 1360 counts at 1100 cm-1, about 1500 at 1300-1700, about 300 at 2999 cm-1). Not a spike; probably fluorescence or instrument response, not subtracted here

citations: Cancado, L. G. et al., Quantifying defects in graphene via Raman spectroscopy at different excitation energies, Nano Lett. 11, 3190 (2011), [arXiv:1105.0175](https://arxiv.org/abs/1105.0175), DOI 10.1021/nl201432g. Source for D/G/D'/2D assignments and the L_D relation (formula from memory).

Eckmann, A. et al., Probing the Nature of Defects in Graphene by Raman Spectroscopy, Nano Lett. 12, 3925 (2012), [arXiv:1207.2058](https://arxiv.org/abs/1207.2058), DOI 10.1021/nl300901a. Source for the I_D/I_D' defect-type ratios (values from memory).
limits: Helper scripts from the ramanlens skill were not run. They are stored outside this working folder, and I was limited to this folder. All fits were done directly with numpy/scipy/lmfit on ./spectrum.csv.

The spectrum covers only 1100-2999 cm-1. It has no Si first-order line (520.7 cm-1), so the wavenumber calibration cannot be checked against Si. The G position (1579.3) is therefore uncalibrated, and a calibration offset of a few cm-1 cannot be excluded.

The L_D value (17 nm) and the defect-type ratio thresholds come from my memory of Cancado 2011 and Eckmann 2012. I searched for the papers (they exist, with the DOIs above) but did not read the formulas or the thresholds in the text. Treat them as to-be-verified before quoting.
The L_D relation applies to the low-defect (inter-defect-distance) regime. I_D/I_G ~0.5 is consistent with that regime, but the relation's applicable range was not verified here.

The layer number rests on a qualitative reading (2D width and I2D/IG). I did not apply a quantitative layer-count relation; the thresholds I cite are from memory and not checked here. Monolayer vs few-layer is not fully separated.

The D' component is weak (about 0.16 of D). Its amplitude is determined to about 18%, and it sits on the tail of the G band, so the vacancy-like assignment is tentative. A boundary-type contribution is not excluded.
Strain and doping cannot be separated with a single spectrum and no Si or reference-graphene calibration, so both are reported as undetermined.

The 2D width (32.3 cm-1) is somewhat broader than the commonly quoted monolayer range. This could reflect disorder, strain, a few-layer contribution, or a sample-specific width; the spectrum alone does not settle which.
No polarization or angle series was provided, so the polarization pattern for each peak is not reported (set to null).
The spectrum does not include the 2D' band (about 3240 cm-1), so the 2D' cannot be used as a further check on layer number or defects.
